product: Rollei Retro 80S, 35 mm, exposed at EI 80/20
spectral_revision: Rollei Retro 80S data sheet, 2021-01-15, 6 pp., page 3 spectral sensitivity
process: Tetenal Neofin Blau, one 30 ml flask to 500 ml, 6 min at 20 C, first 30 s continuous then 2 inversions per minute; exposed at EI 80/20.

measurement.target: gray card on a photo wall
measurement.instrument: Wallner MC 505 enlarging meter, relative logD on the enlarger baseboard

spectral_axis: Rollei page-3 ordinate 0.0-3.0, read as relative log sensitivity with an arbitrary zero; 15 plotted circle centres from 350 to 800 nm. Not absolute log sensitivity and not equal-energy corrected.
limitations: Third-party forum densitometry, not a manufacturer curve; Zone I-X only, one stop per zone.
35 mm measurement only; no 120-specific curve and no ID-11/D-76 curve were found.
The first measured zone (I, 0.05) is used as the base-density proxy, not a measured D-min.
No toe below Zone I or shoulder above Zone X was measured; extensions are model assumptions.
Zone IV (0.36) is lower than a smooth S-curve would suggest; it is kept as measured, not corrected.
The Wallner MC 505 is an enlarging meter reading relative logD, not a calibrated diffuse densitometer.
Data are from 2010-2011; current 2026 batch equivalence is unverified.
The spectral ordinate is a relative log-sensitivity reading; the absolute ISO anchor is model calibration, not a film measurement.
No measured base spectrum, halation PSF, RMS/MTF instrument, or scanner response is supplied.

extraction.characteristic: manual transcription of the ten Zone I-X logD values from APHOG post #40; one stop per zone
extraction.spectral: pdftocairo page-3 SVG; 15 filled-circle centres; 350-800 nm linear axis; relative log-sensitivity ordinate
